mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_role_permissions WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_code = #{permissionCode}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM iam_role_assignments ra JOIN iam_roles r ON r.role_id = ra.role_id AND r.is_enabled = TRUE JOIN iam_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = ra.role_id WHERE ra.principal_id = #{principalId} AND ra.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ra.valid_from <= #{now} AND (ra.valid_until IS NULL OR ra.valid_until > #{now}) AND rp.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND rp.permission_code <> '' ORDER BY rp.permission_code
